events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the tragic passing of The Beatles' John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: A true icon. Remembering John Lennon today, whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Still one of a kind, David Bowie's legacy shines on.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, still shaking up the world with his music.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! Still inspiring guitarists everywhere.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82
angles.copy: Eighty-two and still rockin'! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66
angles.copy: Our House is celebrating! Happy 66th birthday to the fantastic Suggs of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', born in 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young 71
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home! Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton 81
angles.copy: Here she comes again! Happy 81st birthday to the living legend, Dolly Parton. Still working 9 to 5 and beyond!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow 56
angles.copy: He's still the greatest day! Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77
angles.copy: Caribbean Queen is turning 77! Happy birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock Hall of Fame's First Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its first ever induction ceremony.

angles.name: Rock Hall Firsts
angles.copy: Back in '89, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame kicked off its inductions. Who was your dream first-ballot entry?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55
angles.copy: It only takes a minute, girl, to wish Mark Owen a very happy 55th birthday!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles took to the roof for their last live gig. What a moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76
angles.copy: Against All Odds, he's 76! Happy birthday to the legendary Phil Collins.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, known for romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant 67
angles.copy: Oh, Hugh! Happy 67th birthday to the charming British actor, Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake 46
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back at 46! Happy birthday to the brilliant Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940, known for Only Fools and Horses, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason 87
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing the national treasure Sir David Jason a very happy 87th birthday.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, on the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley, born in 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61
angles.copy: We're never gonna give him up! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music still brings sunshine to the soul.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, known for 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King 85
angles.copy: You've Got a Friend in her music! Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of 'The Voice', Whitney Houston, who died in 2012 at age 48.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the phenomenal Whitney Houston today. Her incredible voice is truly missed.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the day Take That originally announced their split.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been that long since Take That first said goodbye? Thankfully, they came back for good!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell 68
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and 68 years young! Happy birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran 36
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud, he's 36! Happy birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, born in 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison 84
angles.copy: Here Comes the Sun for George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. Still deeply missed.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey 83
angles.copy: Hope he doesn't get fooled again! Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's legendary frontman, Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop star Nik Kershaw, born in 1958, known for 'Wouldn't It Be Good', celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw 69
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to wish Nik Kershaw a happy 69th birthday today? We think so!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin, born in 1977, celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin 50
angles.copy: Yellow there! Wishing Coldplay's Chris Martin a very happy 50th birthday.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock icon Jon Bon Jovi, born in 1962, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi 65
angles.copy: He's halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Chris Rea, born in 1951, would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea 76
angles.copy: Driving Home for Christmas, and thinking of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: The Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, born in 1944, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Mary Wilson 83
angles.copy: Stop! In the name of love, remembering The Supremes' Mary Wilson, who would have been 83 today.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut
events.blurb: On this day, Michael Jackson first introduced his iconic Moonwalk dance at Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever in 1983.

angles.name: Moonwalk Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago today, Michael Jackson glided into history with the Moonwalk. Still mesmerising!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: New Wave pioneer Gary Numan, born in 1958, known for 'Are 'Friends' Electric?', celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Numan 69
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? We're certainly wishing Gary Numan a very happy 69th birthday today!
